summary: The exact three-game scope, current claim-envelope hashes, mapper ID references, 12-item asset denominator, and additive v1-v4 byte immutability check out, but Batch B is not acceptable. Authentic role provenance is absent; required game-specific evidence is incomplete; the truth suite does not semantically re-derive all claims or fixtures; browser v3 is an unapproved third stop-loss cycle and uses only synthetic DOM input; asset live corroboration and a fresh additive review are missing. Village Guardian's completion 400 is separately classified as a successor porting bug, not proof that the observed start/active/result UI did not run.
blocking_findings: [critical][evidence_acceptance_blocker][COR-001] The active role-receipt chain cannot authorize acceptance. Evidence: the v4 selector covers eleven receipts, but BatchBReceiptContract reproducibly reports 86 absent prompt/context/session/event/final-response/commit/isolation values; browser-v3 and truth-v4 receipts explicitly retain nulls; strategy section 2.2 and A15 require tool-attested append-only receipts. Exact remediation role: orchestrator must re-dispatch discovery-auditor-batch-b, all three evidence-collector-<game>-batch-b roles, all three requirements-mapper-<game>-batch-b roles, truth-test-author-batch-b, browser-auditor-batch-b, asset-auditor-batch-b, and adversarial-reviewer-batch-b; each owner must emit an additive provider-attested receipt bound to its exact output commit, without retrofitting unavailable IDs.

[high][evidence_acceptance_blocker][COR-002] Village Guardian and Archer's Revenge are incomplete against the cohort protocol despite the B0-B3 green selector. Evidence: Archer's mapper records copy=0, assets=0, developer_effort=0, transitions=0 and explicitly lists developer-effort decomposition and transition reachability as blocking unknowns despite reachable historical source; Village's denominator lists villageGuardianConfig.ts and its pure-model test but none of twelve claims cites them, while baseline config/source lines define three opponent variants and speeds, chase strengths, three lives, max monsters, trail rescattering, and life loss that the package omits. Exact remediation role: evidence-collector-village-guardian-batch-b and evidence-collector-archers-revenge-batch-b must publish additive complete ledgers/reports, then requirements-mapper-village-guardian-batch-b and requirements-mapper-archers-revenge-batch-b must publish additive fully backed blueprints.

[high][evidence_acceptance_blocker][COR-003] The truth suite overstates B3 semantic and fixture coverage. Evidence: test_all_factual_claims_are_exercised_by_exact_or_bounded_checks only counts 62 records; mechanical_semantic_check checks extracted route/literal/number atoms and requires only 15 exercised claims; fixture tests directly re-derive only two semantic overstatements and two directory types, not every one of the twelve fixtures. This violates strategy sections 4.1-4.2. Exact remediation role: truth-test-author-batch-b must publish an additive test supersession that validates every atom of every claim, executes/hash-checks each bounded absence, re-derives all fixtures, and enforces per-game completeness; exposed defects return to the exact collector/mapper owner.

[high][evidence_acceptance_blocker][COR-004] Browser v3 is not admissible as real-input evidence and was dispatched as an unapproved third stop-loss cycle. Evidence: LAST-BATCH-STATUS records two of two cycles and requires product-owner direction; browser-v3 is based on the later stop-loss commit and no Batch B owner-direction artifact exists; browser-v3 records trusted_native_input_events=0, every event isTrusted=false, a hidden tab, and injected requestAnimationFrame schedulers, while v4 affirmatively accepts those synthetic events as input. Exact remediation role: product-owner-batch-b must first issue immutable stop-loss direction; if authorized, browser-auditor-batch-b must create fresh compact/wide foreground evidence with actual browser input primitives and no timing replacement for the acceptance claim, and truth-test-author-batch-b must reject synthetic-only proof.

[high][evidence_acceptance_blocker][COR-005] No independent review covers browser-v3/truth-v4/head d4e3fb5e, and v4 points future review checks at immutable v1 paths. Evidence: B5 fails active-browser-v3-hash-not-reviewed and audited-head-predates-active-browser-v3; review-v2 covers browser-v2/truth-v3; v4 hardcodes batch-b-adversarial-review.json and adversarial-reviewer-batch-b.json, which cannot be overwritten under A15. Exact remediation role: truth-test-author-batch-b must publish an additive selector for a new review-v3 and receipt; then adversarial-reviewer-batch-b must review the final descendant head and exact active bytes with zero unresolved evidence blockers.

[medium][evidence_acceptance_blocker][COR-006] Asset evidence is stale relative to runnable Village Guardian evidence. Evidence: the active asset audit says browser corroboration unavailable, interactions=0, and live_usage unavailable for all twelve records; browser-v3 later establishes a runnable route/network capture, but no asset supersession binds loaded/not-loaded evidence; v4 tests only unique paths/status labels. Exact remediation role: asset-auditor-batch-b must publish an additive audit bound to the authorized final browser capture with exact request/resource evidence or an explicit blocking unknown for each Village candidate, followed by truth-test-author-batch-b coverage.

[medium][evidence_acceptance_blocker][COR-007] Collector validation prose contradicts git diff --check (A5). Evidence: the audited range reports trailing whitespace in Archer method lines 3-4 and Village method lines 3-5, while Archer's final report records verification.git_diff_check as passed. Exact remediation role: evidence-collector-archers-revenge-batch-b and evidence-collector-village-guardian-batch-b must correct the claim through additive superseding artifacts; truth-test-author-batch-b must bind the exact command and exit code.
nonblocking_findings: [medium][successor_porting_bug_not_evidence_acceptance_defect][PORT-001] Village Guardian's terminal UI runs, but both completion POSTs return 400 because the legacy page sends xpEarned, accuracy, correctAnswers, and totalAttempts while createCompleteRoute validates a contract requiring gameType, difficulty, score, duration, victory, idempotencyKey, and clientTimestamp and rejects xpEarned. This does not negate observed GET-200 start/active/result states; preserve it as a factual observation. Exact remediation role: implementation-engineer-batch-b must fix the successor completion adapter and add an integration test proving terminal submission returns 200.
evidence: Scope independently reconciled to exactly Village Guardian, Archer's Revenge, and Storm the Castle Tower across spec, plan, strategy, discovery v2, claim packages, browser v3, and v4 tests.
The v4 full module result was reproduced: 43 passed, 3 subtests passed, 6 failed; failures are provenance, stale/unresolved review, and absent acceptance-chain gates.

The B0-B4 selector was reproduced as 38 passed, 11 deselected, 3 subtests passed; review found that semantic completeness, fixtures, real input, and asset-live requirements are not represented strongly enough for those passes to establish acceptance.
The B4 selector was reproduced as 8 passed, 41 deselected; those passes validate artifact fields but incorrectly admit synthetic input and source-only asset evidence.
All 62 declared positive/bounded claim envelopes pass the current exact-byte tests; no sampled hash mismatch was independently found.
Current v1/v2/v3 truth modules and browser v1/v2/v3 artifacts byte-match their original output commits; supersession has been additive through browser v3 and truth v4.
The twelve asset records are unique and their current source/hash anchors pass the active source-only asset checks.
